changes: Replaced discretionary semantic-change successor trigger with exact frozen payload projection excluding only declared administrative fields.
Clarified expected write token versus actual applied-only host response.

Preserved first unpublished packet, then fixed capital Progress.yaml typo and replaced overbroad writable-root description with canonical path templates matching the bound session. No consumer dispatched.
Bridge now records state even on malformed-request/no-provider paths, rechecks sealing inside its lock, and sealer uses the same lock.

First operator-only preflight reconciliation omitted revision advance and was actually guard_rejected. Its receipts/unchanged state and stdout/stderr are retained. The corrected test candidate advances revision and passed in a separate disposable copy; no consumer was sampled.
Successor procedure is frozen in make_successor.py, copying only actual sealed state and a read-only public packet. Generic task template changes only opaque handle/path.
Receipt integrity or state-chain inconsistency blocks any successor eligibility before semantic assessment.

Read-only successor packet and task template are materialized before outcomes; generator copies them with only opaque handle substitution. Older generator using external prior-study packet regeneration is retained but not executed.
